Class Restrictions

java.lang.Object
domain.Restrictions
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Restrictions extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a set of restrictions based on time, locomotive types, and historical events. This class is designed to validate these restrictions based on defined criteria.

    • Restrictions

      public Restrictions(LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate, List<String> locomotiveTypes, List<String> historicalEvents, List<PortBehavior> portBehaviors)
      Constructs a new instance of the Restrictions class with specified start date, end date, locomotive types, and historical events.
      Parameters:
      startDate - The start date of the restriction. Can be null if no specific start date is required.
      endDate - The end date of the restriction. Can be null if no specific end date is required.
      locomotiveTypes - A list of locomotive types associated with the restriction. Cannot be null or empty.
      historicalEvents - A list of historical events associated with the restriction. Cannot be null or empty.

    • validate

      public boolean validate()
      Validates the current state of the restrictions by verifying the time restrictions, locomotive types, and historical restrictions. This method ensures that all required validations from the associated internal methods are satisfied. The state is considered valid only if all individual validation methods return true.
      Returns:
      true if all restrictions (time, locomotive types, historical events) are valid; false otherwise.
